question: A limits[].kind for a time or inactivity limit is missing: a 10-minute free trial, a UDP tunnel idle for five minutes and a tunnel inactive for 7+ days are all limits that fit no term.
why: tunnelto, port-buddy and ghosttunnel-cushell each publish a time-based limit; the nearest terms (volume-quota, retention-clamped) describe bytes or stored data, so the true term is named in the records' text instead (AGENTS.md section 2 rule 12).
